#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long fastExpo(long long x, long long k) {
    if (k == 0) return 1;
    if (k == 1) return x % MOD;
    long long root = fastExpo(x, k / 2);
    long long ans = (root * root) % MOD;
    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        ans = (ans * (x % MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    return ans;
}

long long modInv(long long x) {
    return fastExpo(x, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    long long N, M, L, R;
    cin >> N >> M >> L >> R;

    long long total = R - L + 1;
    long long E = total / 2 + ((R % 2 == 0 && L % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0);
    long long O = total - E;

    long long prod = N * M; // assume product fits in long long and positive
    long long ans;
    if (prod % 2 == 1) {
        ans = fastExpo((E + O) % MOD, prod);
    } else {
        long long term1 = fastExpo((E + O) % MOD, prod);
        long long term2 = fastExpo((E - O) % MOD, prod);
        ans = (term1 + term2) % MOD;
        ans = (ans * modInv(2)) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
